summary.text: Nicole Macri is a Democratic member of the Washington House of Representatives from District 43-Position 1 (Seattle), where she has served since January 2017, and she is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot seeking re-election.
She is Vice Chair of the Appropriations Committee and Deputy Director of the Downtown Emergency Service Center.

paragraphs.text: Nicole Macri was first elected to the Washington House in 2016 and took office on January 9, 2017.
The House Democrats' biography describes her as a legislative leader on housing, health care access, and protections for LGBTQ people and people with disabilities.
It lists her as Vice Chair of the Appropriations Committee, a member of the Health Care and Wellness Committee, and co-chair of the Legislative LGBTQ Caucus.
Outside the Legislature, Macri is Deputy Director of the Downtown Emergency Service Center, which provides housing, integrated health care and other social services in the Seattle area.
She received the National Homelessness Law Center's Human Right to Housing Award in 2022.
